name: Re-export does not activate a static open extension

input.fixture_ref: Compile one consumer importing only a facade re-export and another directly importing the extension Module.

applicability.reason: Requires a facade-versus-direct-importer distinction. Import scope is now enforced (META-V911 observes it), but `export import` re-export declarations do not parse, so a facade cannot be built to check that it exposes the name without activating the extension.

expect.status: The facade exposes the name but not the static extension; only the direct importer can resolve the extension member.
